crossRefs.note: Esau said to Jacob, “Please feed me with some of that red stew, for I am famished.” Therefore his name was called Edom.

people.name: Leah
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of six sons and Dinah

people.name: Rachel
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin

people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother, Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”
translations.bsb: Now during the wheat harvest, Reuben went out and found some mandrakes in the field. When he brought them to his mother, Rachel begged Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”
translations.kjv: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes.
translations.asv: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes.
